title: WORK-STORE S1: work.db (SQLite WAL, live VM, separate file) + items/events schema with hash chain + filing validator + computed due_at + POST/GET /api/bot/work/items behind WORK_STORE_TOKEN
note: docs/plans/WORK-STORE-DESIGN-2026-11.md §2 and §6 S1. Approved under D1+D3. Operator popup 2026-11-04 ~23:37Z (relayed by Manager Session 2026-11-04b), verbatim: D1/D3/D4/D5/D7/D8/D9 "Approve all 7 (Recommended)"; D2 "Funded drain (Recommended)"; D6 "Not now (Recommended)". Generation Discipline rule 3: operator OK = D1; the canonical sources are the checklist + pipeline files (backfill = S2). Not a gate: G1 carries over the existing refusals, G2 is the write token, G3 is optimistic concurrency (doc § Gates). CLOSES WHEN: a synthetic item written from a cloud session appears in GET /api/bot/work/items within 1 s with its event row and a valid hash chain (merged + deployed + observed). CI saving: none by itself (enabler). OPERATOR STEP FOR D3 (needed when S1 is merged and before S3 writes): one line, verbatim for the popup: "Generate a random value (openssl rand -hex 32), add it as the GitHub Actions secret WORK_STORE_TOKEN, paste the same value into the credential form the S1 lane opens for host ict-bot.duckdns.org (Authorization: Bearer), then reply WORK_STORE_TOKEN provisioned." Everything else is the lane's: add WORK_STORE_TOKEN to OPTIONAL_SECRETS in sync-vm-secrets.yml (step 0 PR, with the NAME: ${{ secrets.NAME }} lines), dispatch it to write the VM .env, restart ict-web-api via system-actions, and verify 401 without the token and 201 with it via diag. The value is never pasted in chat (credentials-and-vm-mutations: the operator originates secret values only).
